description: 1 x Magnolia (applicants ref. T1) - Reduce the density by crown thinning approximately 20% including the removal of dead wood, liftinTCP/0727/25g of low branches, and the necessary trimming back from the house, ensuring the height and basic shape is retained. It is important to prune branches at convenient growth points, rather than an all round reduction or pollarding which is not permitted.1 x Cherry (applicants ref. T2) - Lightly thin by approximately 15% including the removal of dead wood, lifting of low branches, and the necessary trimming back from the hedge, ensuring the basic shape is. retained. It is important to prune branches at convenient growth points where possible.1 x Willow (applicants ref. T3) - Reduce the density by crown thinning approximately 40% including the removal of dead wood, lifting of low branches, and thenecessary shaping of the tree. The height may be reduced by removing the vertical growth in the upper crown bysome 25% whilst retaining the natural weeping shape, it is important to prune branches at convenient growthpoints where possible. 1 x Sycamore (applicants ref. T4) - Remove dead wood and reduce by 20%. Cut back to convenient growth points. 1 x Silver Birch (applicants ref. T5) - Remove dead wood.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
